metaDescription: Order custom spandex pullovers for your team. Perfect for activewear and uniforms. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Spandex pullovers offer a stretchy, form-fitting option for teams and staff who need flexibility during physical activity. Unlike traditional cotton pullovers, spandex versions move with the body and wick moisture, making them ideal for sports teams, fitness centers, and outdoor crews. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that holds up to repeated wear and washing. The Jerzees® Super Sweats® Pullover Hooded Sweatshirt is a popular choice in this material category.
heroAltText: Custom spandex pullovers in various colors with team logo screen printed on chest
